ai_detector_desc: The app that runs CowCatcher and CalvingCatcher on your own computer.
ai_detector_text: Information about the AI Detector application.
ai_detector_hero_subtitle: One app for both CowCatcher and CalvingCatcher. It watches your barn cameras on your own computer, records what it sees and alerts you on your phone.
ai_detector_hero_img_alt: The Recordings page of AI Detector with detected mounts
ai_detector_about_p1: At Cowcatcher AI, we train and develop the vision models. The AI Detector is the app that applies these models in practice: it reads your cameras, recognizes heat and calving, and tells you when it matters.
ai_detector_about_p2: You install it like any other program. Setup runs in your browser in three steps — cameras, detection, start — and a preset supplies everything the AI needs. Presets also keep your detectors up to date with newer models by themselves.
ai_detector_video_desc: From download to the first alert: a short tour of setup, Telegram alerts, the AI check and the recordings.
ai_detector_image_desc: Every detection is saved with the best captured moment, with the detection box drawn on it. In Telegram you get the picture right away and can confirm it or mark it as a false alarm with 👍 or 👎.
ai_detector_video_desc_clip: The detector also records a short, smooth video of the event, regardless of your computer’s performance. Useful for heat detection: you see straight away whether a cow is standing still or actively mounting.
ai_detector_feature_local_desc: Your footage stays on your farm. Detection runs entirely on your own computer — on an NVIDIA GPU, Windows ML, the Apple Neural Engine or a Jetson.
ai_detector_feature_network_desc: Open the dashboard on your phone, tablet or laptop via aidetector.local. Connect with a one-time code and put it on your home screen.
ai_detector_feature_custom_title: Presets That Stay Up to Date
ai_detector_feature_custom_desc: Choose Cow Catcher or Calving Catcher and you are done. Newer models arrive by themselves; no configuration files needed.
ai_detector_feature_alerts_desc: Alerts with photo and clip, 👍/👎 buttons, several recipients and quiet hours at night.
ai_detector_feature_check_desc: Let Google Gemini double-check each clip before you get an alert, to filter out false alarms.
ai_detector_feature_monitor_desc: Live status per camera, a 30-day history of what was really watched, offline notifications and a heartbeat.
ai_detector_step_1_desc: The cameras on your network are found by themselves. Check the pictures and give each camera a name.
ai_detector_step_2_desc: Pick a preset — Cow Catcher for heat, Calving Catcher for calving — and the cameras it should watch.
ai_detector_step_3_desc: Monitoring runs in the background, also when you close the browser. Detections appear in Recordings and on your phone.
ai_detector_install_desc: Download, open, done. Setup happens in your browser.
ai_detector_install_win_desc: Windows 10 (22H2+) or 11. Extract the zip and run the setup. Uses an NVIDIA GPU when present, otherwise Windows ML.
ai_detector_install_mac_desc: macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon. Open the .dmg and drag AI Detector to Applications.
ai_detector_install_docker_desc: Ubuntu package, Docker container for an NVIDIA PC, or a Jetson Orin with JetPack 7.2.
